summary: Iteration 40 — Board Fundraising Activation Batch 1 verification. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_batch1_activation.py (29 tests: 28 PASS, 1 FAIL — the FAIL is an intentional static-source assertion that proves a CRITICAL bug in claim_recruitment_purchase). Also did UI smoke checks on /activate, /activate-with-rooney, /activate-your-board-yourself, /board-activation-proposal, /activation-start-here. Public funnel, video config endpoint, DIY $497 and DWM $2,497 checkouts, intake context (404/402/200) and submit (idempotent, active<=total validation, DIY→/activation-start-here vs DWM→calendly redirects), course endpoints (401 no auth, 403 for module-tester on activation, 422 for module 6), and cross-product regression (recruitment/reactivation DIY still work) all pass. UI verifies exact CTA text, guarantee text, testids, and $497/$2,497 pricing on all four activation pages. /activate lead-form submit redirects to /activate-with-rooney. /activation-start-here redirects logged-out to /login?next=/activation-start-here.

critical_bug_confirmed.issue: Entitlement ladder has branches for recruit_with_rooney, direct_diy_board_recruitment, direct_diy_board_reactivation, recruitment — but NO branch for offer_source='direct_diy_board_activation' + tier='497'. Any paid DIY Fundraising Activation claim will fall through to the else and raise HTTPException(400, 'This purchase is not a Recruitment program purchase'), granting NO entitlement. The purchase.update block at line 117 for direct_diy_board_activation is dead code because the 400 raise happens first.
critical_bug_confirmed.impact: Checklist Item 6 (DIY PAYMENT + CLAIM) BROKEN — buyers of Do It Yourself Board Fundraising Activation $497 cannot claim their purchase, cannot receive activation_self_guided entitlement, cannot access the 5-module app. This blocks the entire DIY buyer journey. UI is fine; the block is server-side.
critical_bug_confirmed.reproduction: POST /api/payments/activation-diy-checkout, complete the Stripe test-mode payment with card 4242…, then POST /api/members/register with the paid session_id → server returns 400 'This purchase is not a Recruitment program purchase'.
critical_bug_confirmed.fix:
Add elif branch in claim_recruitment_purchase before the else, e.g.
  elif offer_source == 'direct_diy_board_activation' and tier == '497':
      entitlement = 'activation_self_guided'
      product_name = 'Do It Yourself Board Fundraising Activation'
The purchase.update at line 117 already handles the metadata correctly once execution reaches it.

rca of the issue: Copy-paste from the reactivation ladder (which correctly handles direct_diy_board_reactivation + 497 -> reactivation_self_guided) was extended to add the purchase.update block for direct_diy_board_activation (line 117) but the corresponding entry in the entitlement-resolution ladder at lines 70-82 was omitted. Because that ladder terminates with a raise-400 in the else clause, the ladder-missing offer_source is rejected before reaching the purchase.update block, making the update block dead code. One-line elif addition fully resolves the bug.
